# Version constraints for pip-installation.
#
# This file doesn't install any packages. It specifies version constraints
# that will be applied if a package is needed.
#
# When pinning something here, please provide an explanation of why. Ideally,
# link to other information that will help people in the future to remove the
# pin when possible.  Writing an issue against the offending project and
# linking to it here is good.

# Common constraints for edx repos
-c common_constraints.txt

# drf-yasg 1.21.17 ships redoc-old/redoc.min.js with "//# sourceMappingURL=redoc.min.map",
# but the bundled file is redoc.min.js.map, so collectstatic (ManifestStaticFilesStorage) fails.
# Same regression as https://github.com/axnsan12/drf-yasg/issues/855. Remove once fixed upstream.
drf-yasg<1.21.17
